headlines.description: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker punctuated a 31-point night with a pair of 3-pointers, Dyson Daniels and Jalen Johnson each finished with 20 points, and the Atlanta Hawks beat the Orlando Magic 132-125 in the season opener for both teams on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nickeil Alexander-Walker pours in 31, leads Hawks to season-opening 132-125 win over Magic

headlines.description: — Anthony Davis had 34 points and 12 rebounds in his debut with Washington, and the new-look Wizards beat the Milwaukee Bucks 128-116 on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davis scores 34 points in his Washington debut, leading the Wizards over Milwaukee 128-116

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards hit nine 3-pointers and scored 45 points to join an elite club, LaMelo Ball scored 21 in his Minnesota debut and the Timberwolves spoiled Giannis Antetokounmpo's first game with Miami by beating the Heat 131-106 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Edwards scores 45, Wolves roll past Heat 131-106 to spoil Giannis' opener

headlines.description: — Naz Reid had 20 points and 11 rebounds in his Charlotte debut, Grayson Allen added 21 points off the bench and the Hornets beat the Brooklyn Nets 110-103 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Naz Reid has 20 points and 11 rebounds in his Charlotte debut as the Hornets beat the Nets 110-103

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard scored 23 points in his return to Toronto, Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley also had 23 apiece and the Raptors routed the Chicago Bulls 135-92 on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kawhi Leonard scores 23 points in Toronto return as Raptors rout Bulls 135-92

headlines.description: — Ty Jerome scored a career-high 45 points as the Memphis Grizzlies used a third-quarter rally enroute to a 123-103 victory over the Utah Jazz on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ty Jerome' s career-high 45 points leads Grizzlies to a 123-103 victory over Jazz

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Pascal Siakam scored 30 points, including 12 in the final quarter, Tyrese Haliburton added 23 points and 12 assists in his first regular-season game since rupturing his right Achilles tendon 16 months ago and the Indiana Pacers beat the New Orleans...
headlines.shortLinkText: Siakam and Haliburton lead the Pacers past the Pelicans, 123-120

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 points apiece and the Houston Rockets used a big second quarter to build a huge lead and coast to a 128-110 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durant and Smith each score 30 points to power the Rockets past the Mavericks 128-110 in the opener

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Walker Kessler scored 26 points on 12-for-12 shooting and grabbed nine rebounds during his auspicious debut for the Los Angeles Lakers in a 127-105 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker Kessler has perfect Lakers debut with 12-for-12 shooting in 127-105 win over Warriors

events.name: Phoenix Suns at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Damian Lillard scored 25 points in his first regular-season game since rejoining the Trail Blazers, leading Portland to a 124-83 season-opening rout of the Phoenix Suns on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lillard returns with 25 points, Morant debuts and the Blazers rout the Suns 124-83

headlines.description: — Darius Garland scored 30 points and the Clippers routed the Sacramento Kings 121-96 on Wednesday night in Los Angeles' first season opener without
headlines.shortLinkText: Kawhi-less Clippers roll past the Kings in a wire-to-wire season-opening rout
